mapper.sql: select 'appeal' as kind, a.id, a.status, a.session_id, s.topic_id, t.name as topic_name, a.node_id, a.create_time, a.resolution_note from orient_score_appeal a left join topic_route_session s on s.id = a.session_id left join cms_topic t on t.id = s.topic_id where a.member_id = #{memberId} and a.status = 0 and a.status != 0 union all select 'dispute' as kind, d.id, d.status, d.session_id, s.topic_id, t.name as topic_name, null as node_id, d.create_time, d.resolution_note from orient_result_dispute d left join topic_route_session s on s.id = d.session_id left join cms_topic t on t.id = s.topic_id where d.member_id = #{memberId} and d.status = 0 and d.status != 0
mapper.select: select kind, id, status, session_id, topic_id, topic_name, node_id, create_time, resolution_note from () mine order by create_time desc, kind asc, id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}

select count(*) from club_governance_ban where target_member_id = #{memberId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and ((source_type = 'CLUB' and expires_at is not null and expires_at > #{now}) or (source_type = 'PLATFORM' and expires_at is null))
